audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 2, 4, 5 and 6 flipped as one atomic paired group in both layers to Poppy, Skill, Skill, Skill, Ornn, Skill, Skill. Row 0 to 6/10 (the inverse of the mirror's 4/10), row 3 to 5/10, row 4 to 3/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three problems. Ornn's W is named 'Searing Bash' in two places — the real name is Bellows Breath, and Searing Charge is his E. The page also warns about a 'Q knockup': Volcanic Rupture makes a magma pillar, the knockup comes from Searing Charge colliding with terrain. And the decisive interaction is absent — that pillar is terrain, so a pillar behind Ornn arms your Heroic Charge stun.
audit.why: A fabricated ability name and a knockup on the wrong slot both mislead the dodge; and the free stun setup his own kit hands you was never stated.
audit.corrected: Names fixed, the knockup attributed to Searing Charge into terrain, and the pillar-as-wall interaction added with the placement condition (it must be behind him). Bellows Breath added as a cancel on your Keeper's Verdict channel.

edits.before: Passive shield trades + Q zone control win early. Identify how Ornn contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Your Q chunks a share of his big HP bar while his poke is flat, and he has no way to disengage — contest the first wave and you win it.

edits.before: W deletes his dash mid-flight — hold it like a parry. Only take the trade when Ornn's Volcanic Rupture is down.
edits.after: Q and E online. His own magma pillar is terrain — if one sits behind him, Heroic Charge stuns; if not, you just shove him away.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Ornn must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Every tool up to punish a misposition against terrain, but his pillars and Brittle poke keep it read-dependent. Hold the wave near you.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Volcanic Rupture's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: An even farming standoff: your damage stalls while his resists climb. Engage in the 9-7s after Volcanic Rupture, and only toward a pillar.

edits.before: Keeper’s Verdict punts the fight’s biggest threat across the map. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Ornn's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Call of the Forge God plus a Searing Charge into his own pillar is his one flip — and Bellows Breath cancels your Keeper's Verdict channel.

edits.before: Iceborn Gauntlet is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Volcanic Rupture's cooldown.
edits.after: Iceborn Gauntlet keeps you trading, but Living Forge matches your spike with self-forged stats — a wash.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Ornn carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: He builds masterwork resists faster than you build damage, so shift to peel and picks. Ornn carry threat 7/10 — do not duel a finished Ornn.

edits.after: E Ornn into a wall — or into his own magma pillar — Q the zone under him, and leave before Bellows Breath makes you Brittle.

edits.before: Ornn pokes with his W Searing Bash auto-reset and pillars (E) for terrain, but his damage is flat and your Q smashes a percent of his max HP regardless of his armor — you win the straight trade levels 1-3. The trap is his E: it dashes him forward and creates a pillar, and if he hits the pillar he procs Brittle for a bonus knockup. Dodge the E dash, and once you have Q+E at level 2-3, look to E him into your own wall for a clean stun. Don't walk into his pillar when Brittle is up.
edits.after: Ornn pokes with Bellows Breath (W) to apply Brittle and drops pillars with Volcanic Rupture (Q, 9s), but his damage is flat while your Q chunks a share of his huge HP bar regardless of armour — you win the straight trade levels 1-3. The trap is Searing Charge (E, 14s): he charges forward, and if he collides with terrain the impact knocks you up. Dodge the charge, and from level 2-3 look to E him into a wall — or into his own pillar, which counts as terrain for your stun.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 even out — your flat damage doesn't scale with points the way his tank stats and item value climb, so lean on Q max-HP chunk and wall-stun resets rather than expecting a kill. The key dodge is his combo: E pillar in, re-strike it for the Brittle double-knockup, then W (Bellows Breath) Brittle shred. Save your W (Steadfast Presence) to block his E engage or, at 6, to eat his R — Keeper's Verdict's grounding shuts his knockup approach. He gets a real window at 6 with R double-knockup; respect it and don't over-extend without W up.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 even out — your damage doesn't scale the way his resists and item value climb, so lean on Q's max-HP chunk and wall-stun resets rather than expecting a kill. The key dodge is his combo: Searing Charge into a pillar for the knockup, then Bellows Breath for Brittle. Lean on Steadfast Presence's passive resists, which climb as your health drops, and never channel Keeper's Verdict while Bellows Breath is up — it cancels the 140s outright. His real window is 6; do not over-extend into it.

edits.before: This flattens out and tilts his way at 2+ items. Ornn self-forges his tank items and upgrades the whole team's gear, so he out-values you on raw stats while your percent-HP Q damage falls off against a tank built to eat it — plus his Brittle shred chunks your effective HP. You stay relevant the way Poppy always does: W to deny his R and E engages, E to peel his frontline, point-and-click disruption rather than a duel you win. Don't try to solo him down late; use your CC to protect carries and let them shred the tank he became.
edits.after: This flattens out at 2+ items. Living Forge lets him build masterwork resists and upgrade his whole team's gear, so he out-values you on raw stats while Brittle chews your effective HP. You stay relevant the way Poppy always does: E to peel his frontline off a carry, Keeper's Verdict to remove his engage from the fight, point-and-click disruption rather than a duel you win. Don't solo him late; use the CC to protect carries and let them shred the tank he became.
